SET @prov_c := '%s';
SET @id:= '%s';
SET @cat_id := '%s';
SET @send :=  IF((SELECT active FROM sys_report WHERE cat_id = @cat_id and id = @id )=1,0,2);
SET @b_year:=(SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1);
SET	@start_d:=concat(@b_year-1,'1001');
SET @end_d:=concat(@b_year,'0930');

CALL AddCol('hdc','s_rdu8','target1','int(9) DEFAULT 0 ');
CALL AddCol('hdc','s_rdu8','result1','int(9) DEFAULT 0 ');


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS s_rdu8(
  id varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  hospcode varchar(5) NOT NULL,
  areacode varchar(8) NOT NULL,
  flag_sent varchar(1) DEFAULT NULL,
  date_com varchar(14) DEFAULT NULL,
  b_year varchar(4) NOT NULL,
	target int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	result  int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	target1 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	result1  int(9) DEFAULT 0,
PRIMARY KEY (id,hospcode,areacode,b_year),
	KEY (hospcode),
	KEY (areacode),
	KEY (b_year)
) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

DELETE FROM s_rdu8 WHERE id=@id AND b_year=(@b_year+543);

INSERT IGNORE INTO s_rdu8
(
SELECT
@id,h.hoscode,concat(h.provcode,SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.distcode),-2),SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.subdistcode),-2),SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.mu),-2)) as areacode
,@send,DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y%m%d%H%i%s') as d_com,@b_year+543 as b_year
,s1.target,s1.result,s2.target1,s2.result1
FROM
chospital h  INNER JOIN
(SELECT hoscode
,COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(o.hospcode,o.pid,o.seq)) target
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(CHK_ANB = 'Y' AND SUBSTR(d.DIDSTD,17,1) IN(1,2,3) AND d.scount=1
			, CONCAT(d.hospcode,d.pid,d.seq),NULL)) result
FROM tmp_diag_ftw o  
INNER JOIN chospital h ON o.hospcode=h.hoscode AND h.hostype IN(5,6,7,11) AND h.provcode IN(@prov_c)
INNER JOIN t_person_db p ON o.hospcode=p.hospcode AND o.PID=p.pid
LEFT JOIN tmp_drug_asu  d  ON o.hospcode=d.HOSPCODE AND o.pid=d.PID AND o.seq=d.SEQ
GROUP BY h.hoscode) as s1  ON h.hoscode=s1.hoscode
LEFT JOIN
(SELECT hoscode
,COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(o.hospcode,o.pid,o.seq)) target1
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(CHK_ANB = 'Y' AND SUBSTR(d.DIDSTD,17,1) IN(1,2,3)  AND d.scount=1
				, CONCAT(d.hospcode,d.pid,d.seq),NULL)) result1
FROM tmp_diag_ftw2 o  
INNER JOIN chospital h ON o.hospcode=h.hoscode AND h.hostype IN(5,6,7,11) AND h.provcode IN(@prov_c)
INNER JOIN t_person_db p ON o.hospcode=p.hospcode AND o.PID=p.pid
LEFT JOIN tmp_drug_asu  d  ON o.hospcode=d.HOSPCODE AND o.pid=d.PID AND o.seq=d.SEQ
GROUP BY h.hoscode) as s2 ON h.hoscode=s2.hoscode
WHERE h.hostype IN(5,6,7,11) AND h.provcode IN(@prov_c)
);

SET @b_year:=(SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1);
SET @start_d:=concat(@b_year-1,'1001');
SET @end_d:=concat(@b_year,'0930');

DROP TEMPORARY TABLE IF EXISTS tx1;
CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tx1(
SELECT
h.hoscode as hospcode, h.hosname, p.PID, p.CID, p.NAME, p.LNAME, p.SEX, p.BIRTH
,p.HID, p.addr, p.check_vhid, p.NATION, p.TYPEAREA
,o.SEQ,o.DATE_SERV,o.DIAGCODE,o.DIAGTYPE,o.ext_diag,o.ext_diagtype
,d.DIDSTD,d.DNAME,d.AMOUNT,d.GENERIC_NAME,d.ATC_CLASS,1 as f32
FROM tmp_diag_ftw o  
INNER JOIN chospital h ON o.hospcode=h.hoscode AND h.hostype IN(5,6,7,11) 
INNER JOIN t_person_db p ON o.hospcode=p.hospcode AND o.PID=p.pid
INNER JOIN tmp_drug_asu d  ON o.hospcode=d.HOSPCODE AND o.pid=d.PID AND o.seq=d.SEQ
WHERE  d.CHK_ANB='Y' AND SUBSTR(d.DIDSTD,17,1) IN(1,2,3)  AND d.scount=1
	AND o.DATE_SERV BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d
GROUP BY o.HOSPCODE,o.PID,o.SEQ
);

UPDATE tx1 d INNER JOIN tmp_diag_ftw2 f ON d.hospcode=f.hospcode AND d.pid=f.pid AND d.seq=f.seq
SET f32=0;

DROP TEMPORARY TABLE IF EXISTS tx;
CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tx( 
SELECT
d.hospcode,d.PID, d.CID, d.NAME, d.LNAME, d.SEX, d.BIRTH
,d.HID, d.addr, d.check_vhid, d.NATION, d.TYPEAREA
,d.SEQ,d.DATE_SERV,d.DIAGCODE,d.DIAGTYPE,d.ext_diag,d.ext_diagtype
,d.DIDSTD,d.DNAME,d.AMOUNT,d.GENERIC_NAME,d.ATC_CLASS,IF(d.f32 IN(0), 'แผลสด 3.2',null) f32
FROM tx1 as d
);

SELECT
h.hoscode, h.hosname, d.PID, d.CID, d.NAME, d.LNAME, d.SEX
, d.BIRTH, d.HID, d.addr, d.check_vhid, d.NATION, d.TYPEAREA
,d.SEQ,d.DATE_SERV,d.DIAGCODE,d.DIAGTYPE,d.ext_diag,d.ext_diagtype
,d.DIDSTD,d.DNAME,d.AMOUNT,d.GENERIC_NAME,d.ATC_CLASS,d.f32
FROM
tx d
INNER JOIN chospital h ON d.hospcode = h.hoscode
WHERE 1=1 {where}

zone.label: เขตสุขภาพ
zone.query: SELECT h.zone_code as a_code ,h.zone_name as a_name, SUM("target") "target" ,SUM("result") "result" ,SUM("target1") "target1" ,SUM("result1") "result1"  FROM chospital_regis as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hoscode=s.hospcode AND s.b_year={{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} LEFT JOIN cmastercup ON s.hospcode = cmastercup.hsub WHERE (h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) AND (h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})) AND (h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}})) AND (h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) AND (ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) AND (cmastercup.hsub IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) GROUP BY h.zone_code,h.zone_name ORDER BY h.zone_code

hospital.label: โรงพยาบาล
hospital.query: SELECT h.hoscode as a_code ,concat(h.hoscode,':',h.hosname) as a_name , SUM(target) target ,SUM(result) result ,SUM(target1) target1 ,SUM(result1) result1  FROM chospital as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hoscode=s.hospcode AND s.b_year={{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} WHERE h.hostype IN(5,6,7,11,12,15) AND h.hdc_regist=1 AND (h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) AND (h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})) AND (h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}})) AND (h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) AND (ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) GROUP BY 1

service_plan.label: Service plan
service_plan.query: SELECT h.splevel as a_code ,h.splevel as a_name , SUM(target) target ,SUM(result) result ,SUM(target1) target1 ,SUM(result1) result1  FROM (SELECT * FROM ccmihosp WHERE byear={{YEAR}}) as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hcode=s.hospcode AND s.b_year={{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} JOIN chospital as c ON c.hoscode = h.hcode WHERE (c.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (c.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (c.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (c.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (c.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) AND (c.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})) AND (c.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}})) AND (c.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) AND (h.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY CAST(regbed AS DECIMAL) DESC
